about: Precomputed Material 3 color schemes for the material3 skill. Generated; rebuild with the precompute tool.
grid: baseline seed, then hue 0..345 step 15 x chroma 24, 48, 72; a grid seed is MCU TonalPalette.fromHueAndChroma(hue, chroma).keyColor

nearest.achromatic: A seed whose HCT chroma is below 12 (half the lowest grid chroma) is achromatic: use the baseline seed #6750A4 and say "achromatic seed, baseline used". Without Node, HCT chroma is not available: treat the seed as achromatic when max(R,G,B) - min(R,G,B) < 3 (channels 0-255). 3 is the smallest such range of any sRGB color with HCT chroma 12 or more, so this test never sends a colorful seed to the baseline; a near-gray seed with a larger range is matched by hue instead.
nearest.withoutNode: Otherwise compute the HSL hue (0-360) and saturation (0-100). Pick the seed with the smallest circular hue distance to hslHue (d = |a - b|, use 360 - d when d > 180), then the smallest |saturation - hslSat|, then the earliest in the seeds list. Say which seed was requested, which was used, and that installing Node gives an exact scheme.
nearest.withNode: scripts/color index.mjs --nearest #hex applies the same order with HCT hue and chroma (the hue and chroma fields); with Node, writeTheme computes the exact scheme for the requested seed instead.

layout: schemes[seed][variant].light|dark = [contrast 0, 0.5, 1]; each string holds the roles in order, 6 hex digits each
styles: M3 Expressive: schemes (2025 spec). Classic M3: classic[seed][variant] (2021 spec) for the classicVariants, schemes for every other variant (MCU defines those only in the 2021 spec).
